Fallon Sherrock Wins Darts Tournament, Defeating Luke Littler

Fallon Sherrock has won a darts tournament, defeating Luke Littler. She was awarded £501,000 (approximately $670,000) for her victory. Sherrock has responded to criticism following her win.
